name: Bullet chart
purpose: KPI performance at a glance — a measure bar against a comparative target marker and qualitative performance ranges. NET-NEW, chart-expansion programme WAVE 2 lane ② (statistical/gauge), 2026-08-05. Built to the Chart-scatter Layer-1 pattern (toolbar + table spine); PROVISIONAL-AGENT pending Dave's eyeball and conductor registration.
when: answers=comparison AND the reading is one measure against a target plus qualitative performance bands AND span.cols 4–6 — beats stat-card (60, "default — label · value · delta · period, no series") and kpi-tile (50, "a series exists to show") when the BENCHMARK, not the delta and not a series, is the point; yields to both when no target exists.

props.name: rows
props.$note: One row per KPI: measure, target, and three qualitative range breakpoints.

props.name: target
props.$note: Comparative marker — a 3px vertical ink tick spanning the row (brief-ruled: 'marker = ink').

props.name: ranges
props.$note: Qualitative bands (poor/satisfactory/good) BEHIND the measure — CANON greys (#96-D1 ③ RULED), z-order bands→bar→marker confirmed correct (DOM paint order).

props.name: data
props.$note: Real <table class="dv-table"> mirroring measure/target/range values per row (dv-005).

props.name: empty
props.$note: No-data state = the Empty-state pattern by reference.

variants.name: three KPI rows
variants.use: Stacked horizontal gauges (e.g. revenue/satisfaction/retention) sharing one 0–100 domain.

tokens.font-family: type composites via markup class — labels/values .t-cm-chart-label/-value · table .t-cm-legal
tokens.ranges: #96-D1 ③ RULED — CANON greys, minted nothing: --dv-range-1/2/3 literal values mirror canon.css's already-minted --color-grey-200/300/400 (light) and --color-grey-dark-mode-500/400/300 (dark); this snippet doesn't link canon.css so the values are copied verbatim, same convention as --data-series-1 etc. Replaces the retired color-mix(ink,page) approximation.
tokens.axis: ⛔ ds-020 RECEIPTED GAP — pre-DV-D07 ink-at-alpha idiom, not the minted two-channel roles. Copied the mark contract + toolbar per the DIVVY brief, deliberately NOT the axis/grid CSS.
tokens.$survey: Net-new for wave 2. Grounds its vocabulary in Chart-bar (toolbar, series-1 measure fill) and Chart-scatter (table spine).

motion.entry: Each row fades in on a stagger; the measure bar grows from the axis — CSS-only (DEF-003).
motion.hover: Measure bar carries data-tip (measure of domain, target).
motion.reducedMotion: Fade/grow sit inside prefers-reduced-motion:no-preference; global collapse also present.

behaviour.fallback: With CSS on and JS off the gauge canvas renders as an EMPTY <svg> and no row is drawn — dvRender is what fills it. The data is not lost and is not unlabelled: the figure carries a real <table class="dv-table"> inside a native <details>/<summary> disclosure (s116-D2), authored in the markup and not generated, so all three KPIs, their measures, their targets AND their three qualitative breakpoints open and read with no script at all (dv-005 tabular alternative + the a11y spine). The engine REWRITES those rows from the spec when it runs, so the popover value and the table value are one number by construction — and the engine's table spine has no column for a qualitative band, so the three "…to" columns are present with JS OFF and absent with JS ON. Lost with JS off: the chart itself, the value popover, the row fade / bar-grow entry and Copy CSV.
behaviour.$note: Typed #260 (s259-D1 fast follower, the bullet type lane). `script` addresses the ENGINE CORE — dv-render.js is where this component's behaviour begins; dv-render-bullet.js is reached through its type registry and is named in `partial`. `partial` lists ALL THREE registered AUTO-BEHAVIOUR names the snippet actually carries, which is the schema's own wording and the s245-D2 shape for a member carrying 2–3+. The canvas is engine-drawn: data-pt="4" data-pb="16" with data-h = 80 + (rowCount−1)·60 make the plot exactly 60·rowCount, so the partial's band arithmetic lands on #96-D1 ②'s RULED pitch with no special case, and the pitch is CAPPED rather than stretched so a filtered stack keeps its band. `ranges` is an EXTENSION to the s249-D4 spec, declared and validated by the partial — RULING-SHAPED, see notes/_subreports/2026-09-08-260-F3-bullet-candlestick.md.

responsive.rule: DV-D02: compress width, never scale — text must not scale. Static answer: fixed 580×H + horizontal scroll, width always 580. #96-D1 ② RULED: H = 80 + (rowCount-1)*60 (pitch=60 constant, BAKED not JS-derived) — this reference's 3 rows = H 200 (unchanged, formula-verified); a 1-row instance = H 80 with the row band visually identical to any row here. FIT hooks NOT wired — AUTO-BEHAVIOUR markers present but empty (conductor serial); see receipt.

mustNotNeighbour: A second chart re-using data/series/1 for DIFFERENT data in the same journey (dv-014)

accessibility.role: figure role="group" + aria-labelledby → sr-only figcaption; svg role="img" with a data-summary aria-label describing every row's measure and target.
accessibility.name: Figcaption names the chart; each measure bar carries data-tip/aria-label; the real table is the full data surface.
accessibility.keyboard: Measure bars are tabindex 0 with aria-label (value popover behaviour NOT yet wired — see AUTO-BEHAVIOUR gap).
accessibility.nonText: Measure fill ≥3:1 vs the page both modes (dv-016 — DECLARED, not yet render-verified, see receipt). Range tints are DECORATIVE background, not a contrast-bearing channel.

antiPatterns: Raw hex fills for the measure or target (dv-017)
Hardcoded hex range bands instead of a theme-derived tint or (once minted) a real token
Colour-coding the ranges red/amber/green without a ruled status binding (that is the R-D9 status ramp, a different pattern)
Scaling the SVG proportionally at narrow widths (DV-D02 — text must never scale)
A chart without its real data table (dv-005)
